name: Magnific — Image Generator
notes: Captured live 2026-06-28 from the signed-in account. Magnific = Freepik canvas suite (not a single form).
Random GUID ids on some controls (e.g. the Generate button) — match by visible text, never id.
Prompt is a contenteditable rich editor (role=textbox); the runner sets it via focus + paste/InputEvent, not .value.
Generate is disabled (cursor-not-allowed) until the prompt has text — waitForEnabled handles this.
From the tool intro page you click 'Start creating' once to open the editor panel; that step is optional/skip-if-present.
The result tile + per-result download control appear on the canvas after generation — those two steps still need teach mode (empty css = TEACH_ME).
